item.summary: The Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME), Government of India, achieved another significant milestone in promoting self-employment and grassroots entrepreneurship with the release of ₹1,000 crore in Margin Money (MM) subsidy under the Prime Minister’s Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP).
item.title: Union Minister for MSME Shri Jitan Ram Manjhi releases ₹1,000 Crore Margin Money Subsidy under PMEGP to support 11,333 new Micro Enterprises across India
